blocks.p: This Privacy Policy describes how VAIN collects, uses and discloses personal information when you visit or use our services, make a purchase, or communicate with us regarding the Site.
This policy may be updated to reflect changes in our practices or for operational, legal or regulatory reasons. Changes will be posted here along with their update date.

blocks.h2: Collection and use of your information

blocks.p: We collect a range of information depending on how you interact with our services, and use it to communicate with you, provide or improve our services, meet legal obligations and protect rights.

ul: Contact details: name, address, phone, email
Order details: billing, shipping, payment confirmation
Account: username, password, security questions
Shopping: items viewed, cart, loyalty, reviews
Customer support: your communications with us

blocks.h3: Information we collect about your use

blocks.p: We automatically collect usage data through cookies and similar technologies, including access, device, browser, network and IP information.

ul: Companies that support the Site (such as Shopify)
Payment processors
Third parties via pixels and cookies
Service delivery: processing payments, preparing orders, maintaining accounts, handling returns
Marketing and advertising: promotional communications and personalised ads
Security and fraud prevention
Customer support and service improvement

blocks.p: We use cookies to operate the Site, improve our services and run analytics. You can set your browser to refuse them, though this may affect your experience. We recognise the Global Privacy Control (GPC) signal as a valid opt-out request.
We disclose personal information in the following circumstances:

ul: To vendors providing services on our behalf
To business and marketing partners
When you request it or consent to it
To affiliates in order to run the business
For business transactions, mergers or legal obligations

blocks.p: Our services are not intended for minors. We do not knowingly collect information from children. If you become aware of any, you can request its deletion by contacting us. We do not sell or share the information of anyone under 16.
No security measure is perfect. Do not send sensitive information through insecure channels. Retention depends on the need to maintain accounts, comply with the law or resolve disputes.

ul: Access, deletion, correction and portability of your data
Opting out of the sale/sharing of data or targeted advertising
Restricting or stopping processing
Withdrawing consent
Appealing a denial decision
Managing communication preferences

blocks.p: To exercise your rights, contact us. You will not be discriminated against for doing so. We may ask you to verify your identity.
Your information may be transferred, stored and processed outside your country. For transfers outside the EEA we use Standard Contractual Clauses or other recognised mechanisms.
Contact us with any complaint. If you are not satisfied, you may lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

blocks.p: VAIN is the controller of your personal information.
All our products are made and in stock — this is not a pre-order. We prepare your order and ship it the next weekday.
We will email you a tracking number as soon as your order leaves.

ul: Mainland Spain: 2 to 5 working days
Islands and special zones: 3 to 7 working days
International: 5 to 15 working days depending on the country

blocks.p: We work with Correos or SEUR depending on the destination.
The cost is calculated at checkout based on your delivery address.
All orders ship from Spain (European Union). Within the EU there are no customs formalities or extra costs: the price you see already includes any applicable taxes.

For shipments outside the European Union, your order may be subject to customs duties, import VAT and carrier handling fees. These are charged by the customs authority of the destination country and are **the buyer's responsibility**, as the buyer is the importer of record. VAIN does not collect or refund them. If you refuse the parcel rather than pay these charges, return costs will be deducted from your refund.
You will receive a tracking number by email when your order ships.

If you live in the European Union, you have **14 calendar days** to withdraw from your purchase without giving a reason. You will find all the details and the model form on our [right of withdrawal page](/policies/withdrawal).

Beyond the legal right of withdrawal above, we do not accept voluntary returns or size exchanges for change of mind. If the piece arrives faulty or we got your order wrong, we will fix it at no cost to you.
For anything to do with returns, write to us at [support@v4in.com](mailto:support@v4in.com).

blocks.p: We usually reply within 48 working hours (Monday to Friday).

If you live in the European Union, you have **14 calendar days** to withdraw from your purchase without giving a reason. The period starts on the day you (or someone you nominate) receive the last item of the order.
To meet the deadline, it is enough that you tell us of your decision to withdraw before it expires.

You can request withdrawal directly from your account, on your order page, through the [self-service flow](https://account.v4in.com). You only need to give your name and the order reference; you will receive an automatic confirmation email.
If you prefer, you can also tell us by email at [support@v4in.com](mailto:support@v4in.com), giving your name and the order reference. We will confirm that we received it.

Once you have withdrawn, we will refund all payments received, including standard shipping costs, without undue delay and in any case within 14 days of you telling us your decision. We may withhold the refund until we have received the returned items or until you provide proof that you have sent them.
You must return the items without undue delay and in any case within 14 days of telling us of your withdrawal.
